query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.is_active, l.is_test_data, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, o.id as offering_id, o.is_published as offering_is_published, o.is_test_data as offering_is_test_data, lv.name as level_name, s.name as series_name, sub.name as subject_name, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where lv.name in ('Première', 'Terminale') and s.name in ('A1', 'A2', 'C', 'D') and sub.name = 'Philosophie' and l.title ilike '%dissertation%philosophique%' order by lv.name, s.name, l.title limit 24;
